Author: Shekhar Kumar Yadav

sentences.text:
Bench: Shekhar Kumar Yadav
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
Application U/S 529 Bnss No. - 2992 of 2025
Court No. - 83
Hon'Ble Shekhar Kumar Yadav, J.
1.Heard learned counsel for the applicant and learned A.G.A. for the State.

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
2.By means of this application, the only prayer made by the applicant is that a direction be issued to
the trial court to conclude the proceeding of the application under Section 311 Cr.P.C. filed in
Criminal Case (State Vs. Raman Bihari and others), arising out of Case Crime no. 252 of 2013, under
Section 498A, 323, 506 Ipc and 3/4 D.P. Act, P.S. Mahila Thana Rakabgang, District Agra in some
stipulated period, pending in the Court of Civil Judge (J.D.)/Ftc-1, Agra.

3 .  I do not find any ground to pass such order looking to the fact that number of cases are pending before the trial court waiting for its logical conclusion and in the circumstances, no such direction can be issued to decide a particular case within a stipulated time.

However, it is expected that the court below shall consider and decide of the matter pending before it in accordance with law without granting unnecessary adjournments to either of the parties as expeditiously as possible.
4. With the aforesaid, the present application stands dismissed.
